Maintenance and diagram-support release for Carve on Shopware 6.6 and 6.7.

### Added

- Opt-in PlantUML and Puml fence rendering through Kroki. The feature is disabled by default and only contacts Kroki when enabled and a matching diagram is present.

### Changed

- Require carve-php 0.1.4 for the current security hardening, exact AST behavior, and parser/writer convergence fixes.
- Replace deprecated service configuration, pin code-sniffer tooling to tagged stable releases, and update CI runtimes.

The attached ZIP is validated for Shopware installation and contains the matching `0.1.1` plugin metadata.
